candidate.scope: src/runtime/bio/bss_conn.rs (connect state machine, conn_close_socket, conn_free, BIO_new_connect/BIO_new_udp/BIO_new_dgram), cross-checked against bss_dgram.rs and bss_acpt.rs close paths

stop_status: NO_STOP_DEFECT REMAINING IN THE REVIEWED SCOPE. One genuine fd double-close was found and repaired; the independent non-author reviewer reproduced the defect, ACCEPTed the repair, and the probe was then hardened on the reviewer's residual so that it proves closure rather than mere slot invalidation. BIO remains CONTRACTED at mechanism level.

authority.abi: No C ABI change. No exported symbol, extern "C" signature or #[repr(C)] layout changed.
external_contracts: A BIO whose num is INVALID_SOCKET must not be used as an fd by any path.
BIO_free must close an owned descriptor at most once for the BIO's lifetime.
bss_conn.c:170-275 and 280-360 close b->num on retry advance and leave the stale number; the authority's own conn_close_socket does invalidate. This repair restores the helper's invariant.

boundaries.operation: connect retry advance closes the current socket
boundaries.before: Both advance sites called BIO_closesocket((*b).num) and left the dead descriptor number published in the BIO. A later BIO_free, or an info callback that stops the state machine at that point, closed the same number again -- an fd double close whose second victim may be an unrelated object's descriptor.
boundaries.after: Both sites call conn_close_socket, which closes iff num != INVALID_SOCKET and then sets it. Republish happens only through CREATE_SOCKET, so a second close of the same live fd is not reachable.
boundaries.mechanism: ELIMINATED: a BIO holding a descriptor it no longer owns is no longer reachable from the retry path.
boundaries.state: FIXED (author) + INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED (reviewer, mutation control; probe hardened to assert fcntl(F_GETFD) == -1)

divergence.class: documented OpenSSL behaviour that is itself unsafe is not reproduced (AGENTS.md section 17)
divergence.authority_behaviour: The authority leaves the stale descriptor number after both retry advances.
divergence.our_behaviour: The slot is invalidated together with the close.
divergence.observable_delta: While an info callback halts the machine immediately after an advance, BIO_get_fd and BIO_CTRL_GET_RPOLL/WPOLL_DESCRIPTOR report -1 instead of a dead number, and a re-entrant BIO_free no longer touches it.
divergence.compatibility_consequence: No change to return values, error queue, or syscalls on any non-halted path. The halted intermediate state reports the only value that is true: the BIO no longer owns a descriptor.
divergence.status: ACCEPTED DIVERGENCE, recorded here and in code at both call sites

reviewer.author: conversion subagent
reviewer.reviewer: separate adversarial subagent (did not write the change)
reviewer.strongest_reason: Both advance sites close-and-invalidate exactly once through the idempotent helper, and the negative control reproduces the pre-fix double close deterministically (BIO_free closing a replacement descriptor) while the fixed tree passes.
reviewer.signed_scope: Connect-BIO descriptor close/invalidate invariant on blocking and nonblocking advance paths. BATCH evidence. Not a BIO-family discharge.
reviewer.residual_raised_and_fixed: The probe could not distinguish 'closed and invalidated' from 'invalidated without close'; it now asserts fcntl(F_GETFD) == -1 immediately after the advance, before any descriptor reuse.

controls.observed: probe FAILED at bss_conn.rs:1473 'BIO_free closed a descriptor the retry advance had already released' (fcntl left/right -1); restored, git status clean, HEAD unchanged. Re-demonstrated after probe hardening: FAILED exit 101.

bss_conn raw close only inside conn_close_socket (line 302); bss_dgram only inside dgram_clear, which clears init so a later destroy cannot re-close; bss_acpt closes only a not-yet-owned local. No stray close of a BIO-owned fd.

if num != INVALID_SOCKET { shutdown if state==OK; close; num = INVALID_SOCKET }. A second call performs no syscall. The shutdown arm is unreachable from the advances (state is CONNECT/BLOCKED_CONNECT, never OK).

controls.instrument: enumerate every INVALID_SOCKET assignment in bss_conn
controls.observed: two assignments: conn_new (no fd yet) and immediately after BIO_closesocket of the previous value. No invalidate-without-close path.
